scenes.text: Put 100 units of electricity in, get about 28 back. In 2024, U.S. government engineers turned electricity into hydrogen, stored it, and turned it back into electricity.
At full power, about 28 percent came back. At low power, about 35.
America's grid batteries? About 82 percent, according to EIA data from 2019.
That's why hydrogen makes sense where you need the molecule, not just the energy. The full video is on Other End of the Wire.
